doctorAppointment.title: Schedule a doctor's appointment
doctorAppointment.description: You're calling your doctor's office to schedule a routine checkup. The receptionist will answer and help you find an available time slot. Be ready to provide your availability and ask about any preparation needed for the appointment.

jobInterview.title: Tell me about yourself
jobInterview.description: You're in a job interview and the interviewer asks you to introduce yourself. This is your chance to give a 2-minute summary of your background, skills, and why you're interested in this role. The interviewer may ask follow-up questions.

coffeeShop.title: Order at a coffee shop
coffeeShop.description: You're at a busy coffee shop and ready to order. The barista is friendly but the line is moving quickly. Order your preferred drink with any customisations (size, milk type, extras) and perhaps a pastry. Handle any questions about your order.

newColleague.title: Meet a new colleague
newColleague.description: It's your first day at a new job and you're meeting a colleague in the break room. Introduce yourself, make small talk about the workplace, and try to build a friendly connection. Ask questions to show interest in them.

modeGuided.label: Guided
modeGuided.description: Start and stop whenever you want. You control the pace.
modeGuided.tooltip: The microphone waits for you. Start speaking when you're ready and stop when you're done. Nothing interrupts.

modeRealistic.label: Realistic
modeRealistic.description: Open mic, natural flow. Replies can come while you're still speaking.
modeRealistic.tooltip: The microphone stays open. Replies can arrive while you talk, even mid-sentence, like a real conversation.

ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.description: Take a moment to review the objectives below. The conversation starts when you press Start.

tips.job_interview: Sit up, hands on the desk or in your lap. Look at the camera as if you're making eye contact.
tips.phone_call: Pick up your phone and hold it to your ear. Speak directly into it, not at the screen.
tips.social_interaction: Lean slightly forward, as if you're starting a real conversation. Keep your hands relaxed.
tips.ordering_food: Sit or stand up. Keep a real drink or snack nearby if you can, and decide what you'd order before you press Start.
tips.medical_appointment: Sit back with your feet on the floor. You're in the chair across from the doctor.
tips.public_speaking: Stand up if you can, face the camera directly, and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
tips.customer_service: Sit or stand as if you're at a counter. You can take a moment before you speak.
tips.other: Get comfortable and take one breath before you start. Speak out loud, as if the conversation were really happening.
